PROGRAM Main WITH profile=complete authority=conformance

PROGRAM Fact

LABEL base
RETURN 1
LABEL rec
LET $m SUB $n 1
CALL Fact WITH $n=$m INTO $sub
RETURN MUL $n $sub
END PROGRAM
